gloss: beginning of the week; start of the new week

definitions.gloss: beginning of the week; start of the new week (typically Monday)
definitions.explanation: The start of the work week, usually Monday. Commonly used in business and news contexts to refer to the first business day after the weekend.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}けに{会議|かいぎ}がある。
examples.english: There's a meeting at the start of next week.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}けの{月曜日|げつようび}に{返事|へんじ}をします。
examples.english: I'll reply on Monday at the start of the week.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}けの{株式|かぶしき}{市場|しじょう}は{大幅|おおはば}な{値上|ねあ}がりで{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The stock market opened sharply higher at the start of the week.

notes:
USAGE:
{週明|しゅうあ}け is a practical business and media term. It typically means Monday, but after a long holiday it can refer to the first business day back. It follows the same pattern as other ～{明|あ}け words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週明|しゅうあ}けに (at the beginning of the week)
- {週明|しゅうあ}けから (from the start of the week)
- {週明|しゅうあ}けの{月曜日|げつようび} (Monday, the start of the week)

RELATED WORDS:
- {年明|としあ}け: beginning of the new year
- {月明|つきあ}け: beginning of the month
- {明|あ}け{方|がた}: dawn
